arguments.text: Good start. Settle now, long smooth strokes, race rhythm.

6000 m, 5 legs out-and-back of 1250 m (current against on leg 1). Plan: settle just above critical power (pod ~205-215 W shaft) after the start, keep the pod reserve above ~40 pct until 2000 m to go, then spend it gradually; final sprint from about 400-500 m to go. Watch for incidents: rudder weed (speed drop at same power, push_local falls), radio messages, pod drift (pod vs boat-model power disagree). Use pod power for effort, compare legs in same direction.

arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: local push minus fitted current along heading; strongly negative = extra drag (weed on rudder) or local adverse current

arguments.name: boat_to_pod_ratio
arguments.description: boat-model power over pod shaft power; a shift means pod drift or a drag change

arguments.message: GPS speed well below what pod power should give: possible weed or drag

arguments.text: 1.0 min: start hot (pod 310 W vs CP 204, pod reserve 67 pct). Cued ease at 1.0 min. Watches set: pod_reserve_low (w_bal_pod_frac<0.25), drag_jump (drag_gap=push_local-push_along < -0.25 for 25 s). Derived boat_to_pod_ratio=power_w/shaft_power_w (about 0.65-0.68 at start) to spot pod drift. Leg 1 heading north, current against about -0.19.

arguments.reason: check the ease took effect and power settled near CP

text: Cued ease after the hot start (pod 310 W vs CP 204), set plan, watches for low reserve and drag, wake in 90 s.

arguments.text: Ease a touch more. Breathe. A pace you can hold.

arguments.reason: check pod power settled near 205 W and reserve stopped draining

text: Cued ease again: pod 237 W still above the 207 W sustainable level with pod reserve at 33 pct; wake in 2 min.

arguments.text: 3.8 min: paddler 10/10, says done, cannot hold. Pod held ~240 W after two ease cues; pod reserve 22 pct, boat reserve 29 pct. Start overspent the reserve. Easing to just under CP (pod ~195-200 W, GPS ~164 s/500 into current) to refill some reserve before mid-race.
Back off now, recover. Easy steady strokes, you will come back.

text: Cued ease to 164 s/500: paddler at 10/10 with pod reserve 22 pct and power still 240 W, so recover just under CP before the turn.

arguments.message: pod reserve below 8 pct: ease hard before it empties

arguments.reason: after turn 1: check pod power below CP and reserve refilling; compare return-leg current

text: No cue: pod power falling toward CP (216 W) under the 164 s/500 ease target; watch added for reserve below 8 pct, wake after the turn.

arguments.text: Current helps now. Ease off, let the boat run, recover.

7.1 min (1370 m, leg 2 south, current helps +0.13): pod reserve 8 pct, pod 215 W vs CP 204; boat reserve steady 27 pct (boat 136 vs 132). Paddler 9/10 hurting: trust the pod for now. Cued ease to 153 s/500 over ground. boat_to_pod_ratio wandered 0.58-0.67, no clear pod drift yet. Goal: pod near 190-200 W for ~3 min to refill to ~20 pct, then hold ~203 W.

arguments.reason: check the ease held pod below CP and reserve is refilling

text: Cued ease to 153 s/500 with the current helping: pod reserve 8 pct and paddler 9/10, recover below CP before it empties.
No cue: ease cue given 19 s ago is still taking effect; next check is already scheduled.

arguments.text: You are recovering now. This effort is right. Stay smooth.

arguments.reason: check pod reserve refilling at about 195-200 W and how paddler feels

text: Reassured the paddler: pod now 195 W, under CP, so the 7 pct reserve can refill; checking again in 2 min.
